claim: OpenActive is a practical, standardised ingestion substrate for a LocalShout activity-feed custody spike; Instagram/poster scraping should be a supplement, not the first dependency.

sources.title: DSA Peer Review Group Minutes Friday 30 January 2026
sources.evidence: OpenActive funded by Sport England since 2016; core specs include opportunity model, RPDE, booking API, routes; approx. 10m activities and ~4,000 providers at any one time.

sources.title: Locaria - About
sources.evidence: Locaria combines event search, OpenActive RPDE, polygon/local geospatial filtering, poster scanning, URL import, moderation, API publishing and translation.

sources.title: openactive on PyPI
sources.evidence: OpenActive data is decentralised: feeds belong to datasets, datasets to catalogues, catalogues to a collection; no single owner/location.

sources.title: Searching Events by Date - Deprecated
sources.evidence: Eventbrite Event Search API access shutdown notice dated 12 Dec 2019.

sources.title: Community event API, Where Are You?
sources.evidence: Community calendars fail on overpowered write access, stale recurring events, weak filters, timezone handling and curation burden.

recommended_next_build: Prototype an OpenActive -> LocalShout custody importer for Watford + London control area.
